Summary: Global - Video Embed Iframes Missing Title
Issue:
YouTube and Vimeo embeds, especially those added through CMS content, are frequently output without a {{title}} attribute on the {{iframe}}.

The {{title}} is the iframe's accessible name. Without it, screen reader users navigating by frame or tabbing into the player hear only "frame" or the raw URL, with no indication of what the embedded content is. This fails Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) and makes the frame harder to identify and skip, relevant to 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks).

*Recommendation*

1. Require a {{title}} on every embedded {{iframe}} the product or CMS outputs.
2. Ideally describe the specific content (e.g. {{title="Video: A day in the life of a nurse"}}); at minimum, identify the player type.

*Before*

{code}<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/abc123"></iframe>{code}

*After*

{code}<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/abc123" title="YouTube video player"></iframe>{code}

*MagicBullet:* Currently patched sitewide by {{fixIframeElement()}}, which adds a generic "Youtube video player" or "Vimeo video player" title to untitled embeds. Documented as [A11Y006|https://radancy.dev/magicbullet/a11y/#A11Y006].

Summary: Global - Empty Headings and Labels Exposed to Assistive Technology
Issue:
Templates and CMS modules sometimes render heading ({{h1}} to {{h6}}) and {{label}} elements with no content, for example when an optional title field is left blank.

Screen reader users navigating by heading land on items announced as "heading level 2" with nothing after it, and empty labels add confusing stops when exploring forms. This conflicts with Success Criterion 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) and 2.4.6 (Headings and Labels), since the structure no longer reflects real content.

*Recommendation*

Update templates and modules so heading and label wrappers are only output when they contain text, rather than rendering empty elements and hiding them afterward.

*MagicBullet:* Currently patched sitewide by {{init.css}}, which applies {{display: none}} to empty headings and labels via {{:empty}}.

Synopsis2: Ensure when an item gets keyboard focus, it is at least partially visible.
Summary: Global - Skip Link Focus Indicator Obscured or Hard to See
Global - Save Job Button State Conveyed by Text Change Only
Issue:
The Save Job button ({{.js-save-job-btn}}), used in search results, job details, and other modules, signals its state by swapping its visible text (e.g. "Save Job" to "Job Saved"), and some delivery builds remove the text entirely. It exposes no programmatic toggle state.

Changing a button's name to signal state is unreliable: screen readers often don't re-announce the new name, and users can't tell whether the label describes the current state or the action. In addition, iOS VoiceOver and NVDA fail to read state back on this button while it carries a {{type}} attribute. This fails Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).

*Recommendation*

1. Give the button a stable accessible name ("Save Job") that doesn't change.
2. Convey state with {{aria-pressed}}, initialized from {{data-job-saved}} and toggled on click.
3. When the same job appears more than once on a page, keep {{aria-pressed}} in sync on every button sharing the same {{data-job-id}}.
4. Confirm state is announced in iOS VoiceOver and NVDA; if the {{type}} attribute still blocks it, apply {{role="button"}} as MagicBullet does today.

*Before*

{code}<button type="button" class="js-save-job-btn" data-job-id="123" data-job-saved="true">Job Saved</button>{code}

*After*

{code}<button class="js-save-job-btn" role="button" aria-label="Save Job" aria-pressed="true" data-job-id="123" data-job-saved="true">Job Saved</button>{code}

*MagicBullet:* Currently patched sitewide by {{fixSaveJobButton()}}. Documented as [A11Y011|https://radancy.dev/magicbullet/a11y/#A11Y011].

This relates to Success Criterion 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) and 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks).

Add an {{aria-label}} (translated) to the header {{nav}}, unless one is already present. If a header contains more than one {{nav}}, give each a distinct name.

*After*

{code}<nav aria-label="Main">...</nav>{code}

Summary: CMS Content - Table Header Scope Stripped by Editor
Issue:
The CMS WYSIWYG editor strips the {{scope}} attribute from table header cells in authored tables.

Without {{scope}}, screen readers can't reliably determine whether a {{th}} labels a row or a column in complex tables, so cell-by-cell navigation loses header context. This fails Success Criterion 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships).

*Recommendation*

Allow the {{scope}} attribute through the editor's sanitizer on {{th}} elements.

*After*

{code}<th scope="col">Location</th>{code}

Summary: Search Filters - Mobile Filter Panel Triggers Pull-to-Refresh

On mobile, scrolling the open filter panel ({{#search-filters.open}}) past its end chains the scroll to the page, which can trigger pull-to-refresh and reload the page.

Users lose their filter selections and have to reopen the panel. This is especially costly for users with motor impairments or tremors, for whom precise scroll gestures are difficult. This is a best practice issue.

*Recommendation*

Set {{overscroll-behavior: none}} (or {{contain}}) on the filter panel while it is open.

Summary: Search Results - Results Updates Not Announced
Issue:
When filters, pagination, or other actions refresh the results via AJAX, {{#search-results}} is replaced in place with no announcement.

Screen reader users get no feedback that loading started, that it finished, or how many results are now shown, so they can't tell whether their action worked. This fails Success Criterion 4.1.3 (Status Messages).

*Recommendation*

1. Provide a polite live region that persists across updates (outside the replaced container).
2. Announce "Loading new results." when an update starts.
3. When it completes, announce the new count only if it changed, e.g. "15 of 230 results are now available." Count job links ({{a[data-job-id]}}) rather than list items so differing templates are handled.
4. Don't announce during initial page load.

*MagicBullet:* Currently patched sitewide by {{fixSearchResults()}}, using the shared {{#magicbullet-message}} live region.

Summary: Data Form - Form Message Close Link Missing Button Semantics
Issue:
The form message close control ({{.form-message a}}) is a link with no meaningful visual icon, though it dismisses the message rather than navigating.

Screen reader users hear a link, and the control doesn't respond to Space. This fails Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) and relates to 2.1.1 (Keyboard).

*Recommendation*

Render the control as a {{button type="button"}} with an accessible name such as "Close", support both Enter and Space, and give it a decorative, {{aria-hidden}} close icon.

*MagicBullet:* Currently patched sitewide by {{fixDataForm()}} plus {{init.css}}, which adds {{role="button"}} and a CSS "×" icon. Space key support is still to do.
